title: Automated System for Data Collection (ASDC) - 3D & 2D Technical Animation
shortDescription: Instructional 3D/2D animation and custom sculpted Desert Locust visual assets produced to train field officers on the Automated System for Data Collection (ASDC), significantly reducing field reporting errors.
mandateChallenge: Field locust officers across the Caucasus and Central Asia needed a crystal-clear visual walkthrough of geospatial tablet logging and satellite transmission under harsh field conditions.
executionCraft: Combined custom 3D anatomical locust modeling in Blender with crisp UI workflow animation in After Effects, localized across English, French, and Russian.
impactMetric: Measurable Reduction in Field Data Errors · EN / FR / RU
